subject: LLM inference pilot demo — hold while prospect runs CX sprint
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cobalthealthtech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming next week's demo + pilot plan attached

Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we've penciled in a 45-minute technical demo for Tuesday, Nov 30 at 11:00 AM PT focusing on inference latency profiling, quantization options, and a short Q&A with our engineering lead.

I've attached a short pilot plan so your team can see the scope we recommend for a 6–8 week proof-of-concept (goals, success metrics, and a hardware profile). If anything needs to change on scope or attendees, let me know and we can adjust.

Quick agenda (30–45 min):
- 10m: Goals and success metrics
- 20m: Demo (latency, batching, cost controls)
- 10m: Integration/next steps and questions

Attachment: pilot-plan.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

If Tuesday looks tight, propose Wednesday 11:00 AM PT as backup.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cobalthealthtech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@cobalthealthtech.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirming next week's demo + pilot plan attached

Rishi —

Appreciate the materials and the clear agenda. Heads up: our product and CX teams are entering a focused sprint next week to prepare for a major UX launch. That pulled a few of the folks we planned to have on the demo (including our infra engineer who was going to join remotely), and we've also got a couple of folks traveling for customer interviews the week of the 30th.

Given that, we need to pause the demo for now. We still think this is valuable, but the timing is off — would prefer to push the hands-on demo until after the sprint wraps (likely mid-January).

Would you be open to:
- Parking the demo and keeping the pilot plan active
- A short sync in early January to pick a tentative window
- Interim access to a sandbox or recorded walkthrough so our design/PM teams can review while the sprint is active

Sorry for the change — can we revisit the week of Jan 11?

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Product Operations
Cobalt Healthtech

Tom —

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the upcoming UX launch. We can absolutely pause the live demo and keep the pilot plan active. A few proposed next steps to keep momentum without blocking your sprint: 

1) Short-term: I can share a 12-minute recorded walkthrough of the inference flow and key config knobs (link below) and enable a lightweight sandbox so your PM/design folks can poke at response-time knobs.
2) Jan check-in: I'll reach back out the week of Jan 4 to lock a tentative demo window the week of Jan 11; if that looks good for your team we'll get engr. lead on the invite.
3) Credits: We can offer a small sandbox credit package so your team can run a quick cost/latency sweep during the sprint (no need for our infra folks to be involved).

Action items for me (I'll complete before Friday):
- Share recorded walkthrough + sandbox invite (Attachment: nurture-playbook.pdf)
- Add a tentative hold in our calendar for Jan 12, 11:00 AM PT (subject to your team confirming after the holidays)
- Note the deal status as "Nurture - waitlist" in HubSpot and flag for Q1 re-engagement

Tom — would you prefer I reach out on Jan 4 or the first weekday after your team returns from interviews?

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
